  MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, January 25, 2021
  11:30 AM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  January 25, 2021 / 11:30 AM

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Bob Wunderlich; Vice Mayor Lili Bosse; City Manager George
  Chavez; Deputy City Manager Gabriella Yap, Marketing and Economic
  Sustainability Manager Laura Biery; Magdalena Davis; Todd Johnson;
  Beverly Hills Conference and Visitors Bureau CEO Julie Wagner, John
  Bendheim; Linda Briskman; Sandy Murphy; Bianca Heyward; Executive
  Assistant Lisa Karson.

  1) Public Comment

  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee
  on any item listed on the agenda.

  •  No public comment received.

  2) Review Proposed Changes to the City Council Policy & Operations Manual

  •  FY 20/21 Reallocation Initiative Review from March 18 Liaison meeting; total
  amount of reallocation was $545,000 to new initiatives including:
  o ‘As You Wish’ Campaign amplification
  o ‘Visit California’ Expedia Co-op Campaign
  o ‘What If’ Campaign
  o Madden Media Retargeting and Hotel Referral Campaign
  o ‘It’s Always Sunny in Beverly Hills’ Media Campaign
  o Sending Sunshine Hotel Video Partnership Features
  o NBC placement and digital advertisement through the Sojern Network
  o Conde Nast Video Partnership
 CVB/Marketing Committee
June 30, 2021
Meeting Highlights

  3) Review of 2021-2022 CVB Summer/Fall/Holiday Destination Campaign Creative

  •  Campaign creative showcases Beverly Hills through a modern lens, making use
  of vibrant colors, collage design, diverse models and typography for a strong
  visual aesthetic. The three Campaign Flights are:
  o Summer | Far From Ordinary (July – September 21)
  o Fall | Cooler Than Fall (September 22 – November 14)
  o Holiday | TBD (November 15 – December 31)

  4) Future Agenda Items Discussion

  •  The CVB will be coming back in this fiscal year quarterly to meet to discuss
  various projects and their work plan as they did last fiscal year.

ADJOURNMENT
Date / Time:  June 30, 2021 / 6:36 PM
